skills.description:
You launched an ambassador program. 3 applications. One ghosted after week 2. Should you lower the bar? Offer more perks? Spam influencers? This gives you the complete community & ambassador operations SOP — from pre-launch checklist to recruitment to tiered management to retention to governance. Built from Notion (20M users, real ambassador interviews), AFFiNE (60K stars), Asana, and ClickUp programs. By @WeiYipei.

What's inside:
• Pre-launch readiness checklist (6 conditions that must be true before starting)
• 6-step community setup SOP (platform selection → rules → admin standards → monitoring → wiki → metrics)
• Ambassador recruitment system (A+B qualification, application form design, scoring rubric)
• 4-tier progression system (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum with point thresholds)
• 5-pillar incentive framework (Product quality → Beta access → Founder access → KOL path → Full engagement)
• Churn early-warning system + retention playbook
• Event operations SOP (6 event types × full lifecycle)
• Health metrics dashboard (6 core KPIs + 5 ambassador-specific indicators)
• Governance & risk control (behavior code, escalation matrix)
• Real templates: recruitment post, welcome email, annual calendar

skills.description_zh:
># hbase-ops — Apache HBase 2.4.x 运维排障技能

## 简介

面向 HBase 运维人员的全场景排障技能包，基于 Apache HBase 2.4.x 官方文档、HBCK2 工具及社区最佳实践。涵盖从日常巡检到灾难恢复的完整运维链路。

## 适用版本

Apache HBase 2.4.x

## 功能覆盖

### 日常运维

- 集群状态检查（status/canary/hbtop）
- 表/Region/命名空间管理
- 负载均衡与 Normalizer
- 快照备份与 Export/Import

### 故障排查（10+ 种场景）

| 场景                        | 处理手段                           |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| Master 启动卡住             | HBCK2 注入 hbase:meta assign       |
| META 表损坏                 | 在线/离线重建 META                 |
| Procedure 卡住              | bypass 跳过 + HBCK2 修复           |
| Region 卡在 OPENING/CLOSING | unassign → setRegionState → assign |
| WAL 超时                    | HDFS 检查 + 参数调优               |
| RegionServer GC 问题        | G1GC 配置 + 堆内存规划             |
| RS 宕机恢复慢               | WAL 拆分调优                       |
| 磁盘空间不足                | cleaner_chore + TTL 调优           |
| 复制延迟                    | replication 队列清理               |
| Region 分裂/合并失败        | HDFS 空间 + 策略调优               |

### HBCK2 完全指南

14 个命令详解（assigns / unassigns / bypass / setRegionState / setTableState / fixMeta / filesystem / addFsRegionsMissingInMeta / extraRegionsInMeta / replication / regionInfoMismatch / scheduleRecoveries / recoverUnknown / generateMissingTableDescriptorFile），含参数说明、使用场景、安全警告。

### 性能调优

- Memstore / BlockCache / BucketCache 配置
- Compaction 策略
- JVM 调优（G1GC 参数模板）
- Handler / RPC 超时配置

### 容量规划

- Region 数估算
- RS 内存规划公式
- ulimit / 文件句柄建议

### 监控告警

- 关键 Metric 清单
- 日志路径与 GC 日志配置

## 文件结构

```
hbase-ops/
├── SKILL.md                          # 主技能文件（完整指南）
└── references/
    ├── hbck2-commands.md             # HBCK2 命令完整参考
    ├── hbase-shell-ops.md            # HBase Shell 运维命令参考
    └── configuration.md              # 关键配置参数参考
```

## 标签

`hbase` `hbase-ops` `hbase-admin` `hbase-troubleshooting` `hbck2` `hbase-2.4` `bigdata` `nosql` `ops` `运维` `排障`
skills.name: hbase-ops

skills.description: Through fixed enclosure cameras, the system analyzes behavior videos of reptiles (lizards, snakes, turtles) and detects movement frequency and dwell duration between the basking zone (heated area under the basking lamp) and the hiding zone (cave/cool side). It counts hourly transitions and per-zone dwell ratios, and outputs a thermal preference label (e.g. 'basking-preferred', 'hiding-preferred', 'frequent shuttling'). This skill helps assess whether the environmental temperature gradient is appropriate, infers pet health state (such as abnormal lethargy or stress reaction), and guides keepers to adjust heating layout. Application scenarios: vivariums, breeding tanks, reptile farms. The system monitors continuously, generates daily thermal-zone utilization reports, and pushes reminders when abnormalities occur. Skill features: reptiles are ectotherms that regulate body temperature through behavior. Long-term deviation from normal zone-utilization patterns (e.g. constantly hiding) may indicate disease, parasites, or environmental inadequacy. AI-based automatic monitoring helps keepers catch problems early, optimize setup, and improve animal welfare. This skill can be integrated into smart vivarium cameras or reptile-keeping apps. | 通过爬宠箱固定摄像头，分析爬行动物（如蜥蜴、蛇、龟）的行为视频，检测宠物在晒点（加热灯下方高温区域）与躲避区（洞穴、冷区）之间的移动频次、停留时长以及活动节律。统计单位时间内（如每小时）的移动次数和各温区的停留时长比例，输出温区偏好（如'偏好晒点''偏好躲避''频繁穿梭'）。该技能有助于评估环境温度是否适宜，判断宠物健康状态（如异常嗜睡、应激反应），指导饲养者调整加热设备布局。应用场景：爬宠箱、饲养缸、爬行动物养殖场。系统连续监测，生成每日温区利用报告，异常时推送提醒。技能特点：爬行动物是变温动物，需要通过行为调节体温。长期偏离正常温区利用模式（如总躲在躲避区）可能提示疾病、寄生虫或环境不适。通过 AI 自动监测，可帮助饲养者及早发现问题，优化环境设置，提升宠物福利。该技能可集成到智能爬宠箱摄像头或爬宠管理 APP 中。

Do not trigger for greetings, quick factual answers, routine coding or editing, or ordinary multi-step execution.

skills.description: Melody Beattie's Journey to the Heart — an executable toolkit for daily spiritual practice, trusting your soul, and living authentically through 365 daily meditations.  Covers 5 use cases: ① Daily Meditation Practice — use a daily meditation to center yourself and connect with your inner wisdom ("Give me a meditation for today" "What should I focus on today" "Daily reflection") ② Trusting Your Soul — learn to trust your inner guidance instead of external validation ("How do I trust myself" "Why can't I hear my inner voice" "Learning to listen to my soul") ③ Creative Awakening — unlock creative energy by connecting with your authentic self ("I feel creatively blocked" "How do I access my creativity" "Finding inspiration") ④ Spiritual Growth — navigate the path of spiritual development with compassion and patience ("How do I grow spiritually" "What does spiritual growth look like" "Feeling stuck on my spiritual path") ⑤ Healing and Letting Go — release past wounds and embrace the present moment ("How do I heal from the past" "Letting go of what hurts" "Finding peace")  Trigger when users say: "Daily meditation" "Melody Beattie" "Journey to the heart" "Spiritual growth" "Trust my soul" "Inner wisdom" "Daily reflection" "Creative block" "Letting go" "Healing meditation" "Soul journey" "Spiritual practice" or mention: Melody Beattie / journey to the heart / meditation / soul / spiritual / inner wisdom / creativity / healing / letting go.  Related skills: be-here-now (presence), the-power-of-now (mindfulness), the-miracle-of-mindfulness (meditation), radically-happy (gratitude), the-mountain-is-you (self-mastery).
